'''Víctor Manuel Martínez''' (born 1 June 1975) is an [[Andorra]]n former [[middle-distance runner]].<ref>{{World Athletics}}</ref> He represented his country at three World Championships. In addition, he won multiple medals at the [[Games of the Small States of Europe]].
